thread:
maria: @here Quick sync — need final owner matrix and open-blockers for ACME on-prem rollout next Wed. Can owners confirm attachments/status by EOD? :wave:

sahil: I own networking. Still waiting on ACME infra team for firewall rules and peering CIDR ranges. Sent follow-up this morning.

ben: Infra-ops here. I'll handle installer + air-gap bundle packaging. Need ACME CA cert and the package checksum to validate on-site.

june: Security check — do we have the customer's KMS/HSM endpoint and cert chain? If not, that's a showstopper for key injection. Also need audit retention level for first-week debugging. :lock:

oliver: Release eng: Patching the private package signing flow — we'll need a mirror repo access and service account from ACME. Created REL-789 to track.

infra-bot: Created ticket NET-332 for the firewall exception request (assigned to sahil).

sahil: @liam.acme can you confirm allowed egress CIDRs and whether outbound to telemetry/monitoring endpoints is permitted? If telemetry is blocked we need to ship a pull-forward agent.

liam.acme: Hey all — ACME team is compiling the CIDR list, should have it by EOD. KMS endpoint will be provided but requires a signed CSR from your side.

maria: OK dropping a mini-owner/checklist here — paste and update inline. Please mark status (todo/in-progress/done) next to your line.

```
Owner matrix & open items:
- Networking: sahil — todo (waiting on ACME CIDRs)
- Infra Ops: ben — in-progress (packaging, awaiting CA cert)
- Security: june — todo (need KMS endpoint + cert chain)
- Release: oliver — in-progress (REL-789 created, need mirror creds)
- Solutions Eng: maria — coordinating ACME comms

Open blockers:
1) ACME firewall CIDRs + proxy details (owner: ACME)
2) Customer KMS/HSM endpoint + certs (owner: ACME)
3) Mirror repo access + git creds (owner: ACME + release)
4) Air-gap media logistics + courier ETA (owner: infra-ops)
5) Telemetry egress policy (owner: networking)
```

ben: For air-gap we also need the physical media packaging spec and SHA256 checksum prior to courier pickup. Who owns courier coordination from ACME side?

liam.acme: Courier coordination is on our side — I'll get ETA and packaging spec by EOD.

june: Note: if KMS endpoint is hosted behind private network, we need a VPN tunnel or a signed import bundle. Also want to enable verbose audit for 7 days after cutover for traceability.

sahil: If ACME blocks telemetry, propose: (1) local metrics forwarder on internal network, (2) daily pull of aggregated logs via secure SFTP. Which is acceptable? @liam.acme

liam.acme: SFTP pull is preferred for now. Telemetry direct egress is restricted.

maria: Thanks — that clarifies. Next steps: owners update the matrix inline with status by EOD, ACME to send CIDRs + KMS CSR requirements + courier ETA. I'll compile an updated rollout checklist tomorrow morning and tag infra on any unresolved blockers. :white_check_mark:

oliver: I'll add REL-789 notes about manual signing steps and mirror creds needed. Ping me if you want a walkthrough when creds arrive.

ben: I'll prepare air-gap packaging script and SHA256 generate steps, will post by 4pm.

june: I'll draft the temporary audit config and share the terraform patch for toggling verbose logs.

maria: Great — thanks everyone. If anything changes, drop updates here so I can keep the rollout doc in sync. :thumbsup:
